applies_to: headless: Surface.wait(label=new interrupt prompt, 10 s original)
desktop: Desk.wait_for(what=runtime new GUI prompt, 10 s original)
covered_recoveries: interactive top Ctrl-C (all four go through the two waits above)
recovery_wait_policy.interpretation: 120 s = retained phase cap (command_s) measured as observer-pause-credited wall time (wall minus completed observer pause intervals); unlike S10-8 there is no 120 s hard wall-clock cap on the credited wait, only the unchanged 900 s window
recovery_wait_policy.pause_accounting: Observer.pause_ns difference (retained: sum of completed _stopped-handling intervals), same as S10-8
recovery_wait_policy.no_prompt_within_budget: stops the run as before (Stop: timeout ...)
recovery_wait_policy.ceiling: the product 10 s recovery criterion is NOT EVALUATED by these runs (never met, never failed); recorded numbers are observer-throttled QEMU/TCG test-hooks guest numbers and support no product-latency claim
